articles.title: A Big Test for Britain's Leader: Local Elections Could Shake Things Up!
articles.summary: Imagine your teacher getting a report card from the whole school—that's what happened to UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer today. Voters across Britain picked local leaders, and many think Labour could lose big. One expert says the old two-party system might totally collapse.

articles.title: US Slaps Sanctions on Iraq's Oil Boss, Says He Helped Iran Sneak Oil Past Rules
articles.summary: The US just punished Iraq's deputy oil minister, Ali Maarij al-Bahadly, for helping Iran sell oil secretly. The US says Iran uses the money to fund terrorism. This is part of a bigger fight over oil and power in the Middle East.

articles.title: A Grandson's Podcast About His Grandma's Dementia Wins Big Prize—and Opens Hearts
articles.summary: Colby McCaskill, 21, made a podcast letter to his grandpa about his grandma's dementia. It was so honest and touching that it won NPR's College Podcast Challenge. Listening to it made his grandpa cry—but in a good way.
